description: Query the Lyrion Music Server over its JSON-RPC API from the Flask app. Use this whenever a task needs live data from Lyrion — the now-playing track, player list, transport state, album art, or any `slim.request` command — or when adding a feature that reads from the music server. Covers the request format, the tag system, the shared cache, and the self-signed-TLS rules, so new calls match how `services/lyrion.py` already talks to the server.
